summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration efforts with Spark, including variant support and DSv2 API upgrades. Additionally, there are ongoing proposals to enhance the REST catalog with new features like the X-Iceberg-Client-Capabilities header and a first-class Tag concept.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration efforts and bug fixes
Discussion on inconsistent default partition field names for bucket/truncate transforms
Proposal to add OpenTelemetry MetricsReporter to iceberg-core
Introduction of first-class Tag concept in Iceberg REST Catalog
